property_summary: After any call to setOwner by the admin, the owner variable in the reference contract always equals the argument passed, while in the buggy version it remains unchanged from the original owner, so P.owner() == _owner for all inputs but M.owner() != _owner for any input where _owner differs from the initial owner.
change_summary: Delete the assignment 'owner = _owner;' so owner remains unchanged after setOwner call.
